flags.why: This expression is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese but has no regional tag.
This is an insulting command to leave, so an informal tag alone does not adequately warn the learner.
The crab sense is spurious; [Vietnamese dictionaries](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-c%C4%83m%20c%C4%83m) define this word as describing bitter cold.
In this example, triệu chứng cơ năng means subjective symptoms reported by the patient, whereas functional symptoms suggests a different medical concept.
flags.fix: The doctor asks the patient about their subjective symptoms.
